verdict.rationale: Bento is an agent tracing and observability product, so masking or redacting sensitive data before it is stored in traces is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents span capture, OpenTelemetry export and `init()` kwargs (user_id, session_id, tags), but nothing on masking, redaction, PII scrubbing or pre-storage filtering hooks. Any redaction done in a user's own OpenTelemetry pipeline would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.
